query:
SELECT c.id, c.nome, c.empresaSlug, c.ativo, c.exibirNoRanking, c.cashbarberProfissionalId
FROM colaboradores c
WHERE c.empresaSlug = 'barbiero-mascote' AND c.ativo = 1
ORDER BY c.nome;
